meta.act: ACT FOUR · THE BLIP, TOLD TWICE
meta.library: audio/sfx/manifest.json (+ audio/sfx/scripts/sounds_4.py for the v5 additions)
meta.honesty: Nothing here was heard. Levels and placements are measured and reasoned, not auditioned; the mixer's ear decides.

conventions.frame: act frame at 24 fps; 0 = the act's first frame (episode 12:31:00:00). 'frame' is the story frame the sound belongs to (its transient for a hit); 'place_frame' is where the file's first sample (after start_s) goes: frame - hit_s*24, or frame - dur for end_anchor.
conventions.gain_db: applied to the board's master (each master is normalised to -14 LUFS, short ones by momentary max, TP <= -1 dBTP). Reference level: the v5 takes measure -16 LUFS (mono), laid at unity on both channels as mix_v4.py does; the mix is loudness-normalised after the sum.
conventions.beds: each bed is levelled so the bed alone reads target_dbfs_rms (RMS per channel over the loop) before its ride and fades; equal-power fades in frames; layers are summed first (gain_db, optional low/high-pass) and the sum is levelled. Bursty synthetic beds read 1-2 dB under RMS in 50 ms windows (flow bible v4 note).
conventions.pan: -1 left .. +1 right, a balance as in mix_v4.py: the near channel stays at unity, the far one is scaled by 1 - |pan|
conventions.trim_s: play only this many seconds of the file (after start_s), with fade_out_s
conventions.reverse: the (trimmed) segment is reversed before placing
conventions.loop: loop the file (sample-seamless masters) from loop_offset_s until loop_until_frame, then fade_out_s

device.laptop: Neleh's laptop speaker: band-pass 250 Hz - 7 kHz, a little early reflection of her office
device.monitor: Mas's monitor speaker: band-pass 200 Hz - 6 kHz (Gerg's keys and the call's tones on it)
device.cctv: the boardroom wall screen playing the lobby camera: band-pass 180 Hz - 3.8 kHz, mono

conventions.on_words: words of a take within the cue's first 8 frames (the hit), for the mixer's attention; clear_of_words cues were shifted to a gap (shift_f)
conventions.d6: act f 997-1086 (the Cancel click to the phone's buzz): every bus muted; only the click's own first 0.25 s survives. No bed crosses it.
conventions.optional: spotted but off by default: the mixer decides by ear
